We, the Tuttifrutti fraternity is celebrating the festIval of Onam in our homeland today.

Are you wondering what is Onam all about? It's the harvest festival of Kerala state, the southernmost tip of India. We usher in prosperity through the auspicious annual visit of the mythological king Mahabali.

This year there is no family gathering, no grand feast, no hugging, no outdoor games, but.

Corona, so what? We are celebrating "Onam online" with families and friends. Wishing you all and your families a very happy Onam. 

May light and colors of this festival fill your hearts and life with happiness, prosperity, and peace!!

notes.title: Attention: For those who lost "saved profile" after last update
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Some mentioned they lost their profiles after last update.

The profile is not actually lost - in last update we accidentally renamed save location to  "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" to "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE". 

1. This save location can be found by typing "%APPDATA%/Tuttifrutti_games" in windows search bar like this and pressing enter key
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/ba48a2da49ddd85bb79da413fb687a8957062377.png[/img]

2. The "game save location" window will popup.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/65ddc5a03635efea962631f3188367c63e958b5f.png[/img]

3. "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" folder contains old save files.
a. Pls delete new folder "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE"
b. Rename "Darkarta_Qflp_Survey" to "Darkarta_ABHQ_CE". 

You can start playing from old save location ːsteamhappyː

Don't forget to thank our friend Azrael for finding this - Azrael will get all future game, dlc for free :)

Here is his original post in case anybody still has confusion.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/601530/discussions/0/1327844097132209427/#c1327844097133806820

Cheers
Tuttifrutti

Let's Darkarta....
